summaries.text: This resolution supports the designation of October 2025 as Substance Use & Misuse Prevention Month and supports effective programs to prevent substance use and misuse in the United States.

title: A resolution supporting the designation of October 2025 as "Substance Use & Misuse Prevention Month" to raise awareness of substance use and misuse in the United States.
